semantics.edges: Directed authored level-change routes with available destination BSP and required source entity fields. Not live playtested.
semantics.one_way: No reverse confirmed edge exists in extracted topology; not proof that gameplay forbids all other return methods.
semantics.conditional: All routes between the pair have an explicit master, triggered activation, scripted interaction or restricted destination.
semantics.secret: Destination marked hidden by world/server/maps.script, or its authored display title explicitly says Secret. Node hidden and secret_name distinguish these sources.
semantics.unknown: True for unresolved or unusable route records. Invalid/missing/disabled routes are kept outside edges.
semantics.default_visible: Hides filename-suffixed legacy copies, test/utility maps, and self-reloads; disconnected adventure maps remain available.
semantics.geography: No geographic positions or relative distances were inferred.
semantics.global_transition_rules: Normal transitions may require a player vote and can be disabled by GameMaster state. These shared rules are not repeated as per-route conditions.
semantics.access_allowlists: Restricted-map allowed_previous_maps are metadata only and were not treated as physical transition edges.
semantics.arrival_spawns: Missing named arrival spawns are warnings; game can fall back to ms_player_begin during travel.
